reusedGameplayEvidence.reason: Only editor UI/navigation changed. Gameplay/compiler/playtest byte hashes match the preceding full-suite run; those eleven game cases were not rerun.

visualReview.findings: Problem-first buttons show their precise target and diagnostic path. Clicking overlap focuses the affected room inspector and position control; unrelated content is no longer marked selected.

limits: Functional software-rendered checks. Human M4 authoring/handling acceptance and M2 hardware performance acceptance remain open. No new hardware capture, audit, commit, push or deployment.
